name: Catalina Benavides
bio:
Catalina's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While earning her degree in computer engineering at the Universidad de Chile, she volunteered at a local rally team to help them optimize their data analysis systems. This ignited a passion for racing and the critical role technology plays in competitive success.

Over the past two decades, Catalina has honed her skills in managing complex IT infrastructures for various racing teams. Her approach is meticulous and data-driven, always seeking innovative solutions to improve performance and reliability. Known for her unwavering dedication, Catalina is a driving force behind the scenes, ensuring that teams have the technological edge they need to win. She is adept at balancing cutting-edge solutions with dependable systems.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves, often pulled back into a low ponytail during work hours.
physical.description: Catalina is a woman of average height with a focused and intelligent gaze.

quirks: Insists on using a mechanical keyboard for all tasks, regardless of noise level.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas or potential system improvements.
Has a habit of reorganizing cables and wires even when they are perfectly organized.
